verdict.rationale: The evidence shows LiteLLM can disable logging of prompts/responses to its own logging providers (litellm-docs-12), but nothing indicates it offers a mechanism to opt out of model-training use by the underlying LLM providers (e.g., passing zero-retention/no-train flags to OpenAI/Anthropic/etc.). As a gateway, this is a plausible capability, but no evidence supports it.
